annotation.why: Zac's locked spec required the strongest identity-bearing work to lead, at a quality that makes the creator's work itself the argument. The Blue-Chip standard requires real creator imagery, exact identity fidelity, and no visible template or draft compromise. The review record explicitly treats the native-resolution live loop, creator name in front, and matching poster as the passing hero, while naming the soft crop as the defect.

after.outcome: The shipped hero uses native autoplay, muted, looped footage with a matching poster and TOOTRIPSY in front. The desktop and mobile treatments avoid the rejected soft center crop.
